user: Which currency is used for SEPA transfers?
answer:
What I did
- I checked our transfers documentation in the knowledge base.

What I found
- SEPA transfers are sent in euros (EUR) and reach euro‑area banks within one business day.

What happens next
- If you want to make a SEPA transfer, tell me the beneficiary details and amount and I can prepare it for you.

fragments.text:
Transfers
## Transfer types
Internal transfers move funds between Verta accounts and settle instantly.
SEPA transfers reach euro-area banks within one business day. SWIFT transfers
are used for other destinations and settle in one to five business days. Card
payments are outgoing payments to a merchant.

Transfers
## Cut-off times
SEPA transfers submitted after 16:00 CET are processed the next business day.
SWIFT transfers submitted after 14:00 CET are processed the next business day.
Internal transfers have no cut-off.

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Currency conversion operations
## When a conversion happens
A conversion happens when the payment currency differs from the currency of the
account being debited. The conversion is applied at settlement, not at
authorisation.
